title: Personal Sender Account Sending Limit Schedule by Verification Level
content:
Every Personal Sender Account sits at one of six verification levels, and each level carries its own set of sending ceilings. The ceilings are measured on the principal (in USD, to two decimals) of the customer's personal transfers, whatever the delivery method — Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup or Mobile Wallet.

## Schedule of ceilings

| Level (number shown in the app) | Largest single transfer (USD) | Rolling 24 hours (USD) | Rolling 30 calendar days (USD) | Rolling 180 calendar days (USD) | Transfers in rolling 24 hours | Distinct corridors in rolling 30 calendar days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter (1) | 999.00 | 999.00 | 2999.00 | 5999.00 | 3 | 2 |
| Paloma Verified (2) | 2999.00 | 2999.00 | 10000.00 | 18000.00 | 6 | 3 |
| Paloma Verified Plus (3) | 6000.00 | 10000.00 | 20000.00 | 40000.00 | 10 | 5 |
| Paloma Enhanced (4) | 15000.00 | 25000.00 | 50000.00 | 120000.00 | 15 | 8 |
| Paloma Premier (5) | 35000.00 | 50000.00 | 110000.00 | 250000.00 | 20 | 13 |
| Paloma Private Client (6) | 75000.00 | 100000.00 | 250000.00 | 600000.00 | 25 | 13 |

## What each column means

- **Level number** — the verification level number the customer sees in the app, from 1 to 6.
- **Largest single transfer** — the largest principal one personal transfer may carry at the level, for every delivery method.
- **Rolling 24 hours** — the ceiling on the sum of personal transfer principal booked in any rolling 24-hour period.
- **Rolling 30 calendar days** and **rolling 180 calendar days** — the ceilings on the sum of personal transfer principal booked in any rolling period of that many calendar days.
- **Transfers in rolling 24 hours** — the largest number of personal transfers that may be booked in any rolling 24-hour period.
- **Distinct corridors** — the largest number of different destination corridors the customer may send to in a rolling 30-calendar-day period.

## Reading the schedule

**Which figures go up from one level to the next?** Each money ceiling rises at every step from Paloma Starter to Paloma Private Client. The corridor count is the same, 13, at Paloma Premier and Paloma Private Client.

**Is the single-transfer ceiling ever the same as the 24-hour ceiling?** Yes, at Paloma Starter (999.00) and Paloma Verified (2999.00). From Paloma Verified Plus upward the 24-hour ceiling is higher than the single-transfer ceiling.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A customer at Paloma Verified Plus (level 3) can see from the table that one transfer may carry at most 6000.00 USD of principal, that no more than 10 transfers can be booked in a rolling 24 hours, and that sending to a sixth distinct corridor within 30 calendar days would exceed the count of 5. The figures in this illustration are read from the table; the level is chosen only for the example.
